problem_text:
A logistics firm is tasked with transporting ten distinct categories of freight, each necessitating passage through ten sequential handling stages before delivery. The revenue generated per ton for each freight category is listed as follows:
* For Freight Alpha, revenue is 13.469 per ton
* For Freight Beta, revenue is 8.343 per ton
* For Freight Gamma, revenue is 9.171 per ton
* For Freight Delta, revenue is 6.961 per ton
* For Freight Epsilon, revenue is 15.98 per ton
* For Freight Zeta, revenue is 12.43 per ton
* For Freight Eta, revenue is 9.94 per ton
* For Freight Theta, revenue is 18.774 per ton
* For Freight Iota, revenue is 7.996 per ton
* For Freight Kappa, revenue is 6.902 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each stage is provided:
* For Freight Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.317 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.909 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.882 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.261 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.296 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.235 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.377 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.286 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.261 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 0.58 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Beta, Stage 1 consumes 1.839 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.338 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.548 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.238 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.882 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.398 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.573 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.441 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.335 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 0.836 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.969 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.306 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.232 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.258 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.407 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.283 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.991 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.448 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.006 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 0.213 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Delta, Stage 1 consumes 0.642 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.878 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.699 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.553 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.769 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.499 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.698 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.26 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.904 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 1.447 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 0.639 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.979 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.769 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.324 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.39 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.359 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.642 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.276 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.391 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 0.905 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 1.331 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.647 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.989 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.025 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.777 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.258 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.589 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.187 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.446 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 1.652 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Eta, Stage 1 consumes 1.701 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.532 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.468 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.485 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.98 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.747 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.572 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.894 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.434 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 1.861 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Theta, Stage 1 consumes 1.351 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.758 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.608 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.758 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.668 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.179 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.099 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.675 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.472 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 0.351 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Iota, Stage 1 consumes 1.566 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.672 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.109 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.6 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.015 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.095 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.686 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.092 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.756 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 0.964 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Kappa, Stage 1 consumes 0.52 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.938 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.639 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.297 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.844 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.477 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.454 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.862 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.494 (ton-hours), Stage 10 consumes 1.18 (ton-hours)

The cumulative handling duration allocated to each stage is strictly limited:
* The total time for Stage 1 must not surpass 274.887 hours
* The total time for Stage 2 must not surpass 236.372 hours
* The total time for Stage 3 must not surpass 201.57 hours
* The total time for Stage 4 must not surpass 254.489 hours
* The total time for Stage 5 must not surpass 269.661 hours
* The total time for Stage 6 must not surpass 210.456 hours
* The total time for Stage 7 must not surpass 179.313 hours
* The total time for Stage 8 must not surpass 277.976 hours
* The total time for Stage 9 must not surpass 238.143 hours
* The total time for Stage 10 must not surpass 233.439 hours

Under the condition that for every handling stage—Stage 1 through Stage 10—the aggregate processing time must remain within its respective available time allocation, determine the optimal tonnage for each freight category to be scheduled in order to maximize the firm's total revenue.
